title: Abstract Classes, Interfaces and UML
welcome_lead: Sketch designs before code: UML class diagrams meet abstract types.
meta_desc: HL CS adventure on abstract classes, interfaces and UML class diagrams.
final_note: Interfaces are contracts - implement them faithfully!

walkthroughs.body_html:
Abstract Shape declares area().

Circle and Rectangle implement area() concretely.

Comparable defines compareTo(other).

Implementing classes (e.g. Book) define ordering logic.

Box has three rows: name, attributes (- private), methods (+ public).

Arrows show inheritance (▷) and association.

mcqs.q: What does in-order traversal of a binary search tree produce?
options: Nodes in the order they were inserted.

mcqs.q: Which item is removed first from a stack?
options: IP is for input, MAC is for output.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between an IP address and a MAC address?
options: They are the same thing with different names.
MAC is a hardware identifier (fixed); IP is a logical network address (assignable).
IP is for input, MAC is for output.
